title: Courteous Anticipation: Improving Long-Lived Task Planning in Persistent Shared Environments
abstract: arXiv:2607.20289v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider a task planning scenario in which robots sharing a persistent environment are assigned tasks one at a time from a held-out sequence. Standard task planners, lacking foresight of future tasks and inconsiderate of others' constraints, solve each task in isolation, leaving terminal states that increase future cost for all; side effects that compound over lengthy task sequences. To reduce cost over the sequence, a robot must anticipate how its actions now may impact performance on future tasks for all robots sharing the environment. Therefore, we present courteous anticipatory planning, wherein a model-based planner proposes candidate plans and selects the one that jointly minimizes immediate cost and aggregated expected future cost across all robots, estimated via independent per-robot learned estimators. translated_title: 礼貌性预判：改进持久共享环境中的长期任务规划
translated_abstract: 我们考虑了一种任务规划场景：多个机器人共享一个持久环境，任务从一组预留的任务序列中被逐个分配。标准的任务规划器缺乏对未来任务的预见，也不顾及他人的约束，孤立地求解每个任务，其留下的终止状态会增加所有机器人未来任务的成本；这些副作用会在冗长的任务序列中不断累积。为了降低整个序列的成本，机器人必须预判其当前动作会如何影响共享环境中所有机器人未来任务的表现。为此，我们提出了礼貌性预判规划：基于模型的规划器提出候选方案，并选择能够同时最小化即时成本和所有机器人聚合预期未来成本的方案，其中未来成本通过各机器人独立的学习估计器进行估算。这种因式分解的表述避免了组合式的联合推演，并支持模块化部署：添加一个机器人只需……
tldr: 提出“礼貌性预判规划”，让机器人在持久共享环境中求解当前任务时，通过独立的每机器人学习估计器，联合最小化即时成本与所有机器人的聚合预期未来成本，从而避免副作用在长任务序列中累积。
en_tdlr: We propose courteous anticipatory planning, where robots in persistent shared environments select plans that jointly minimize immediate cost and the aggregated expected future cost for all robots, estimated via independent per-robot learned estimators.
